measurement.why: A UTF-8 byte count is a conservative upper bound for BPE tokenizers: the compiler must not promise a context fits a selected model when it does not know that model's tokenizer.
measurement.baseline: The same mandatory task/policy/runtime material plus every locally indexed evidence document. This is the explicit unbounded-retrieval baseline that a harness replaces; it is not a model-generated summary.
